script_format:
About 90 seconds, vertical video.

HOOK (5s): a surprising fact or question.
CONTEXT (15s): what happened and why it matters now.
HOW IT WORKS (30s): the mechanism in 2-3 simple steps.
EVIDENCE (20s): the key numbers, shown as a chart.
SO WHAT (15s): what it means for the viewer, with the main caveat.
TAKEAWAY (5s): one memorable line.

Under each beat, add a 'Visual:' line (chart, real asset, graphic, or text card).
post_format: WhatsApp channel post, under 180 words. *Bold* title, 2-4 short paragraphs, a one-line takeaway, then 1-3 source links. Minimal emoji.
